gloss: end of a performance; curtain fall

definitions.gloss: end of a performance; curtain fall
definitions.explanation: The conclusion of a play, concert, or other live performance. Used in theater and event contexts to indicate when a show has finished.

examples.japanese: {終演|しゅうえん}は{何時|なんじ}ですか。
examples.english: What time does the performance end?

examples.japanese: {終演|しゅうえん}{後|ご}にロビーでサイン{会|かい}がある。
examples.english: There will be an autograph session in the lobby after the performance ends.

examples.japanese: {予定|よてい}より{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}{遅|おく}れて{終演|しゅうえん}を{迎|むか}えた。
examples.english: The show reached its curtain fall thirty minutes later than scheduled.

notes:
USAGE:
Used primarily in theater, music, and event contexts. Often appears on programs and schedules to indicate the finish time. The pair {開演|かいえん} (start of performance) and {終演|しゅうえん} (end of performance) are commonly seen together on event listings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {終演|しゅうえん}{後|ご} (after the performance ends)
- {終演|しゅうえん}{時間|じかん} (end time of a performance)
- {終演|しゅうえん}を{迎|むか}える (to reach the curtain fall)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {終了|しゅうりょう}: general ending or conclusion — broader usage, not limited to performances
- {終焉|しゅうえん}: end, demise — homophone but refers to the end of something in a grander or more literary sense
